title: Three-step certificate verdict
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be one of the $k$ tape slots. Suppose a configuration $d$ has state $0$, tape $c$ contains the word $w$ starting at cell $0$ and is blank elsewhere, and its head on that tape is at cell $|w|$. After three steps of the certificate-verdict machine from $d$, the machine is halted and its output is $d$'s original output followed by the bit that is true exactly when $w=[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: Tape $c$ contains the buffer encoding of a Boolean word $w$
The head on tape $c$ is at position $|w|$
